column3: Kirino Route · There's No Way My Little Sister Is Treating Me Like A Stranger
After a nightmarish night, I've been racking my brains about Kirino from the start of school to my walk back home.
--you-chan! Kyou-chan, are you listening?
...Sorry, I was thinking about other things. What were you saying?
Geez, it's about my little brother～
Ahh, is something up with Rock?
Yesterday, when I went to his room in order to pass him a souvenir, he said "I don't know you!" to my face.
Eh? Could he have forgotten?
No. Not that.
He said "I'm a rockstar with no family or friends! Both now and in the past, I've been living all by myself!"
...That fool, he was influenced by something again.
However, I was frightened for a moment there.
W-Well, isn't it good that it all ended as a joke?
The one that isn't actually doing it as a joke is my little sister.
Ah... Damn it! My brain can't get away from Kirino's matter...
...What's wrong, Kyou-chan? You look rather discouraged?
N-No, it's nothing.
Is that so... that's good then.
Although that's what she said, Manami's eyes seem to be saying "I'm waiting for Kyou-chan to tell me about it".
However, even if I know it's a joke, it's sad to be 【treated as a stranger】...
Ah, here we are. I'll be heading off myself from here. Kyou-chan, see you tomorrow!
Ah, yeah...
Stranger, huh...
Yesterday, the way Kirino looked at me was just like a year ago, as if she's looking at a "stranger".
It's true after all. If it weren't for those otaku-related matters, that girl and I are just like strangers.
...Tch, I don't know why, but for some reason I'm irritated.
I don't mind being hated, but I can't accept that the troubles I've went through over this past year have just been wiped clean.
Besides, it's better to have a favorable impression of "minus 50%" than "minus 100%" from her.
If that's the case, I'll do whatever it takes to get Kirino's memories back!
